openQuestions: This zip completes B29 ('the next 3 nodes for each optional'). The earlier aspiran-B29.zip already covered Geography (B25 ranks 1 to 5), so this one adds the other five optionals and leaves Geography alone.
Public Administration and History had no priority nodes yet, so they get B25 ranks 1 to 3: pa-p1-11, pa-p1-08, pa-p1-07; hist-p1-18, hist-p1-19, hist-p1-45.

Sociology, PSIR and Anthropology already had ranks 1 to 5 from B26 to B28, so they get ranks 6 to 8: soc-p1-12, soc-p1-11, soc-p2-02; psir-p1-36, psir-p1-14, psir-p1-44; ant-p2-09, ant-p2-22, ant-p1-35.
Links use the same made-up slug style as B26 to B29 (for example psir/psir-p1-43-judiciary); Claude Code maps them.
psir-p1-44 cites Supreme Court cases by name and year only, with no quotations from judgments; every case and date is in factsToCheck.
ant-p2-09 presents Risley's racial theory only as a rejected historical view; the Hindi and English editors may want to check the wording on caste with care.
